title: HyperSVG 2.0 capability live-data: Live data
description: a rows content field of the experience may be named in addons.live-data.inputs (D31), as "<field>": {"fallback": "<table>"}: its rows are fed by the host through the host API (player.set), checked as any change; fallback names the bundled data table (2.8) that plays when nothing is fed, when the experience is run packed, and when a fed value is refused (set throws and the field goes back to the fallback rows) | the field declares a table key (2.8); fed rows must fit that table: at most maxRows rows, each closed with every column, each cell of its column's type and bounds, the key unique; the fallback table has a resource and the same key and columns; the field has no initial | repeated uses over the field follow the new rows, keeping the block of each row whose key stays (4.5) | the content never names an address; fetching is the host's work and a network grant is the host's
